blocks.content: Let's see the full pattern. Each class stays small and focused, and the Game class combines them using everything you have learned - classes, constructors, template literals, and object properties.

Here, TaskBoard does not extend Task or User. It creates them in its constructor and uses them through their public methods. Each class stays small and testable on its own. If you need to change how tasks are described, you edit the Task class. If you need a different user format, you change the User class. The TaskBoard class just coordinates.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
